title: export.markdown
description: Writes a Markdown file and copies figure crops into `assetsDir`. Image links in the Markdown are relative: `<basename of assetsDir>/<file>`. `assetsDir` is created only when the document has figures. Never overwrites: fails with IO_ERROR (reason `already_exists`) when `outputPath` or a target asset file exists.

document.description: The Document IR: an absolute path to a Document JSON file (normal use), or the Document object itself (tests and tiny documents).

assetsDir.description: Folder for the figure files, for example `invoice_assets` next to `invoice.md`.
